ev.q: In 2005, of the 66 cases reported, 44 (66%) were confirmed by laboratory testing
Twenty-four (36%) of the 66 infections were imported
incidence rate: less than one case per 1 million population
Overall, 62 (94%) of the 66 cases in 2005 were determined to be import associated
Of the seven visitors (non-U.S. residents) with imported measles, one (14%) had been vaccinated with 1 dose
During 2005, local and state health departments reported to CDC 66 confirmed cases of measles
